subject: Evaluation MAP + sequencing for signature: MSA / DPA / Order Form
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: J. Smith <j.smith@sierramed.com>, procurement@sierramed.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation MAP + sequencing for signature: MSA / DPA / Order Form

Hi J. and Sierra procurement team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great conversation. Per our call, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lines up the evaluation milestones with the legal/procurement sign steps so we avoid surprise gating. High level ask: could you confirm the internal approvers for MSA (legal), DPA (privacy), and PO (procurement) so we can place deadlines on each lane?

Key points in the attached evaluation plan (eval_plan_v1.pdf) and MAP: 
- Pilot window: 4 weeks (tech validation + acceptance QA)
- Legal review: target 5 business days for initial redline review, 3 business days for final signoff if no material changes
- DPA: we can provide our standard DPA for review; acceptance required before production data ingestion
- Order form: pricing and billing contact required to generate order form; provisioning will be scheduled once the order form is executed

Proposed sequencing (short):
1) Sign MSA (master services agreement) — legal redline window
2) Execute DPA as addendum to MSA or as standalone (privacy gating for prod data)
3) Order form signed (triggers billing and provisioning)

Please see the MAP_v2.xlsx template I can send next if you prefer a shared sheet to track owners/dates. Suggested target: signature by 2026-06-04 to keep the pilot timeline intact.

Attachments: [Attachment: eval_plan_v1.pdf (PDF)]

Next steps: let me know approver list and PO/billing contact and I’ll circulate a tracked MAP with clear owners and dates.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: J. Smith <j.smith@sierramed.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sierramed.com, Legal Ops (Sierra Health) <legalops@sierramed.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation MAP + sequencing for signature: MSA / DPA / Order Form

Alex — thanks for the clear summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we lock dates: 

1) SOC 2 evidence: our security team requires the most recent SOC 2 report and a statement on data segregation (we’ll need that before DPA execution). Can you confirm timing to deliver those artifacts?
2) DPA scope: would Redwood’s standard DPA be acceptable, or do you expect us to provide any additional clauses? Our privacy team usually needs 5 business days for review.
3) Order form / PO: procurement needs a formal quote with line items to create a PO. Who on your side will own the quote generation?

If legal review for MSA takes 5 business days, and privacy review 5 days in parallel-ish, we’re looking at ~2 weeks for document review barring redlines. If we aim for 2026-06-04 signature, that should be doable provided we exchange redlines by 2026-05-24.

Can you send the SOC 2 and a sample quote/line-item template? Also please include the single-page summary of acceptance criteria for the pilot so our clinical ops can validate.

Thanks,
J. Smith
Director, Procurement & Vendor Ops
Sierra Health

Deliverables attached:
- MAP_v2.xlsx (editable MAP with owners/dates)
- eval_plan_v1.pdf (pilot acceptance criteria, test cases)
- SOC2-summary.pdf (recent report index + auditor contact) — full SOC 2 report available under NDA; we’ll share a redacted copy via secure link upon request

If you can share the PO billing contact and the internal approver names (Legal: name/email; Privacy: name/email), I’ll populate the MAP and the DocuSign envelope.

Sequencing note (recommended):
- MSA: target sign by 2026-06-02 (5 biz days of review + buffer).
- DPA: target sign by 2026-06-02 (privacy review in parallel; DPA accepted prior to provisioning).
- Order form: execute 2026-06-04 (procure final PO or DocuSign).

Temporary workaround: if legal needs more time, we can enable a limited pre-production sandbox so your engineers run smoke tests without ingesting PHI. Production data ingestion awaits DPA and order form.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP_v2.xlsx (Excel)], [Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF)]

Best,
Alex
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: J. Smith <j.smith@sierramed.com>, procurement@sierramed.com, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Legal Ops (Sierra Health) <legalops@sierramed.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation MAP + sequencing for signature: MSA / DPA / Order Form

Hi all — looping in from legal/ops perspective to confirm sequencing and to clarify a couple of contract mechanics so procurement can prepare.

Contract sequencing (Redwood position):
- MSA must be executed (fully signed) before we provision dedicated resources tied to the agreed order form.
- DPA can be executed as an addendum to the MSA or as a separate agreement; however, data processing for production workloads begins only after DPA acceptance. Sandbox/smoke testing can occur earlier per Alex’s note.
- Order form triggers billing and provisioning. If Sierra needs Net-30 PO terms, we’ll include payment terms in the order form; please confirm billing entity and PO owner.

Legal cadence: we commit to an internal turnaround of 3 business days for any reasonable redline set; please provide tracked changes so we can respond efficiently. If there are material commercial changes (pricing/term length/etc.) that affects risk, we’ll need up to 7 business days.

Acceptance & escrow notes for pilot: the MAP should include a 3-step acceptance checklist (smoke, integration, clinical validation) and the owner for each check. We’ll mark the acceptance criteria in the MAP_v2 and add a column for evidence required (logs, test cases, sample outputs).

Action items (owner / due):
- Sierra to send final approver list & PO/billing contact — due 2026-05-24 (Sierra procurement)
- Redwood to deliver quote & order form draft — due 2026-05-21 EOD (Alex) [in progress]
- Sierra legal to return redlines on MSA/DPA — target 2026-05-28 (Legal Ops)
- Redwood legal to respond to redlines — target within 3 business days of receipt (Redwood legal)

Attachments: [Attachment: redlines_summary.docx (DOCX)]

If Sierra confirms the approver list today or Monday, we should be on track for a 2026-06-04 order form signature and a provisioning window the week of 2026-06-07.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference
